 Litton Das fit for Mirpur Test? Shanto gives injury update
 Bangladesh Test captain Najmul Hossain Shanto has offered an encouraging update on Litton's injury. According to him, Litton appears fit enough to play, but the final decision will depend on the report from the team's physio and trainers.
 Written by : Khan Mutasim Billah Life 
 Posted - Oct 27, 2026, 10:50 pm 2026-10-27T22:50:07+06:00 
 Updated - Oct 27, 2026, 10:50 pm 2026-10-27T22:50:07+06:00 
 Limited-overs captain Litton Das missed the tri-series due to injury, and Bangladesh looked unsettled without him. He was in excellent form with the bat in the Abu Dhabi Test and also impressed behind the stumps. Now, the big question is whether he'll be fit to play in the Mirpur Test.
 Bangladesh Test captain Najmul Hossain Shanto has offered an encouraging update on Litton's injury. According to him, Litton appears fit enough to play, but the final decision will depend on the report from the team's physio and trainers. "Litton worked on his fitness this morning and is doing well. The physio and trainer haven't submitted their report yet. If everything is fine, he'll play. I haven't received the final report yet, although he has done everything in practice, including batting and keeping," Shanto said.
 Meanwhile, Mushfiqur Rahim picked up a minor knock during training on the eve of the match. However, Shanto said it wasn't anything serious.
 Get Latest Cricket Updates on WhatsApp The captain also spoke about the value of having experienced batters in the middle order and explained why Mominul Haque had been working on his bowling. "Mominul bhai can bowl, so he bowled. He used to get a bit of rest in between, but that opportunity is no longer there," Shanto said.

"Having experienced batters in the middle order is certainly reassuring for a captain. They've been playing for many years, and they know their game and their roles," he added.
